title: JANUS retrocausal quantum pathways: reviewed primary research and testable synthesis

reviewed_research.title: Retrocausal Capacity of a Quantum Channel: Communicating through Noisy Closed Timelike Curves
reviewed_research.authors: Kaiyuan Ji, Seth Lloyd, Mark M. Wilde
reviewed_research.result: One-shot classical/quantum and asymptotic retrocausal capacities of noisy postselected-CTC quantum channels are characterized; this assumes the mathematical class of channel and does not demonstrate a physically accessible backward channel.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Compute candidate channels/noise thresholds and require explicit physically measured input-output map.

reviewed_research.title: Experimental simulation of postselected closed timelike curves for decoding scrambled quantum information
reviewed_research.result: Four-qubit experiment on cloud Quantinuum and IBM quantum processors; postselected data can be interpreted as decoding a scrambled state before its generation. Authors explicitly state no actual physical time travel or backward message channel.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Reproduce conditioning and success probabilities with all shots, not only postselected shots.

reviewed_research.title: Toward an Experimental Device-Independent Verification of Indefinite Causal Order
reviewed_research.result: Quantum switch violates Bell-like causal order criterion; setup is not loophole free and does not establish past-directed classical signaling.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Keep causal-order witnesses separate from backward-signal witnesses.

reviewed_research.title: Experimental violation of a Bell-like inequality for causal order
reviewed_research.result: Four-party inequality violation 5.7 standard deviations using 3-km fiber spools; not fully device-independent, bidirectional signaling loophole remains.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Specify adversarial leakage controls and detector timing.

reviewed_research.title: Experimental superposition of a quantum evolution with its time reverse
reviewed_research.result: Coherent superposition of forward/reverse channel-use direction allows operator discrimination advantage; not a message transported into laboratory past.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Distinguish time reversal of quantum operation from reversal of causal event timestamps.

reviewed_research.title: Experimental Demonstration of Input-Output Indefiniteness in a Single Quantum Device
reviewed_research.result: Highly statistically significant input-output indefiniteness witness, not a pre-target recoverable classical signal.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Do not equate input/output indefiniteness with an operational messaging protocol.

reviewed_research.title: Experimental simulation of closed timelike curves
reviewed_research.result: Photonic simulation reproduces nonlinear features expected in qubit CTC models, including nonorthogonal state discrimination. No CTC physically created.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Compare predictions of simulation and chronology-respecting controls.

reviewed_research.title: Nonclassical Advantage in Metrology Established via Quantum Simulations of Hypothetical Closed Timelike Curves
reviewed_research.result: Postselection-enhanced metrological task, not earlier classical communication; improved information available only at end of experiment.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Report postselection yield and unconditional advantage separately.

reviewed_research.title: Quantum operations with indefinite time direction
reviewed_research.result: Quantum time flip and indefinite input-output direction, with physically inaccessible operations assumed in some interpretations. No past-message channel proven.
reviewed_research.janus_next: Formalize which allowed operations can be implemented with ordinary cloud hardware.

distinct_hypotheses.H0: For a future bitstring drawn from cryptographic randomness after a sealed earlier prediction, accuracy is 1/2 per bit regardless of the trained model; no backward-time channel.
distinct_hypotheses.H1: Early sealed predictions carry reproducible mutual information about a future independently generated target, absent classical leakage or postselection, under predefined timing and analysis.
distinct_hypotheses.H2: Postselection yields strong correlations in a selected subensemble only, while complete early records remain independent of later choices.
distinct_hypotheses.H3: Quantum time flip and indefinite causal order exhibit physical process advantages that do not imply a controllable message received before it is sent.

measurements: 256 fresh bits generated at least 120 seconds later
precommit and send GitHub run IDs
experimental_lanes.raw_test: Unconditional time-ordered prediction accuracy versus p0=0.5
experimental_lanes.retrocausal_claim_necessary_conditions: Positive precommitted excess information, external independent replication, closed leakage channels, no model- or timestamp-retrofitting, physically characterized channel.

experimental_lanes.predicted_outcome: Conditional correlations can reach 100% in a toy entangled/Bell-basis statistical model without any early accessible message.
experimental_lanes.physical_interpretation: Toy control only; do not claim to reproduce hardware results of Huang et al.

measurements: public oblast-level alarm starts as non-safety statistical task
experimental_lanes.classification: Known forward-time learnability, not retrocausal capacity

methodological_gates: G0: A received result must be physically recorded/hashed before independently sampled future input exists.
G1: No late information may influence early bytes through shared seeds, logs, CI dispatch inputs, model checkpoint updates or metadata.
G2: Unconditioned early bit/target prediction is the primary statistic; postselected-only gains are a separate control.
G3: Use exact binomial tests for each prespecified 256-bit trial; combine independent trials only with pre-registered stopping and multiple-comparison control.
G4: Re-training uses only outcomes of completed prior runs; current future labels are never used.
G5: Demonstrate a physical interface to the claimed postselected/CTC channel before using the label 'physical backward communication'.
